# Roadmap: Production / Application Support

## Role overview

Keeps live business apps running and fixes production issues.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 1+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)

## Also needed

Bash, Python, ITIL, Runbooks, Splunk, ServiceNow, Dynatrace, AppDynamics

## Where it leads

Grow: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), DevOps Engineer · Lead: Project Manager · Pivot: Backend Developer, Cloud Engineer
